items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And he would sit in the room there, this lady, Mrs. Gibson, she had a piano.

ctx.x: Yeah, to be able to get some rhythms going.
Right, I'd not be humming anything, just be playing by myself. And it happened, where we were staying there was a guy that lived in one of the rooms. We were rooming in those places.
